title: Concept: innerHTML as an HTML sink
description: Assigning to innerHTML parses the value as HTML, so markup in the string creates elements and event handlers instead of showing as text. The rule flags the sink; whether the value can carry attacker input is what review has to establish.
applicability: JavaScript and TypeScript source that manipulates the DOM.
risk: DOM cross-site scripting when the value is attacker-influenced; MEDIUM severity pending review.
